cells.gaps: No source says any town hall is connected: no count, share or place is given, and no use over a connection is named. `institutional` describes the connection the programme is to provide, not one in service. Owner is not held: the only owner fact (COG-007) is of May 2022, outside the 36 months, and the 2022 appraisal's plan (COG-006) gives no period; plan:current rests on the 2026 work plan and budget in COG-003.
cells.note: The steering committee of 26 February 2026 asked for internet access to town halls to be continued and intensified, which is a programme in preparation. Stage 3 needs a connection live in some local governments outside the capital, and none is stated.
